newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein on pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein on pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan flew to Saudi Arabia on Thursday for a pilgrimage to Mecca and a meeting with King Fahd, a palace official said.
King Hussein flew to Mecca and was expected to travel to Riyadh for talks with King Fahd, the official said.
The two leaders put aside six years of bitterness last year when King Fahd, who snubbed the Jordanian monarch during his February pilgrimage, met him for talks in August on Middle East peace efforts.

Jordan's ties with its large oil-rich neighbour were strained in 1990 when King Hussein refused to join Saudi Arabia and other Arab and Western countries in a military coalition to recapture Kuwait from occupying Iraqi troops.
The king, whose great-grandfather was ruler of Mecca until its capture by King Fahd's father King Abdul-Aziz in 1924, will perform the minor pilgrimage of Umra.
